_evidence: Family layout for the 22 car records at 0x66fef0 (stride 0x41c; spec registers use rec[0x66fef0,0x41c,0..21]) and the per-function scalars that select among them. Car +0x1c is the current track-segment pointer into the 0x160-stride array at 0x8943a0 (see state_00432330), so it draws a record address 0..25; the segment word +0x1a (0x43b51c: & 0x7ff, then 0x405985) and byte +0x51 (0x42f450: bit 7) of all 26 segments vary. Car fields: i8 +0x67 (0x43b51c cbw into cx for 0x405985, whose 'sub cx,0x40' loop runs at most 3 times), i16 +0x68 (0x42dc22 bp compare), u8 +0x7a (bit 7, 0x43b8be) and +0x8d (bit 2, 0x43b51c), i16 +0x90/+0x94/+0x11c/+0x11e (0x42db77 via 0x42dc22) and +0x90/+0xb0 (0x42dee4: +-0x200 compares), i16 +0xb6 (0x42a0cf clamp), u16 +0xea (0x42dee4 tests 0x10/-0x10; 8/-8 for 0x42b84b's family), u8 +0xfd (0x43b8be key compare; 0..24 against eax 0..30: first, second, no match and late matches), u16 +0x1bc (0x42e2f1: 0xffff or a car byte offset k*0x41c compared with ebx-0x66fef0), u8 +0x21c (0x42f450 bit 0). 0x42dc22 loops edx = [0x6078dc] .. [0x6078e0]-1 (jae/jb, unsigned; both 0..4) over the car-pointer table 0x6078e4 (filled with car pointers by 0x42f8bf), so its 4 slots draw car addresses; 0x60414e selects the 0x42db77 path (0 / |8| / other = stc), 0x60414c its sub-path (0 / sign). 0x604280 equals ebx in half the cases (0x42dee4 cmp ebx,[0x604280]). 0x868558/0x86856a/0x868568 are the wrap length and 0x405985 base/scale (mul word: no fault). 0x6223e8/0x6223f4 feed 0x42a0cf. Every pointer read is a fixed record, so nothing faults; all other fields are plain draws. Car byte +0xfd draws 0..24 (0x43b8be matches) or values with the high bits set (0x4322d9 masks it with 0x1f). 0x4322d9 (esi = car) compares the car's segment pointer +0x1c unsigned with [0x891500] (jae: read its word +0x1a) and [0x866f00] (jb: stc), both record-aligned pointers into the segment array (0..26, both orders, as state_00432330); in between it follows the segment link +0x44 (0 -> stc, else a segment record 0..25) and reads that record's +0x1a. 0x868562 is a 0..0x7ff word (as 0x868564), 0x62a944 an offset and 0x62a940/0x62a93c the signed window (+-0x400..0x800: all three outcomes). 0x433d52 (esi = car) selects dwords +0x118/+0x11c or +0x120/+0x124 of the car's current segment (+0x1c) by the sign of word +0x90; all 26 segments vary those dwords. 0x43b576 copies the 22-word order list 0x66fe3c (each word 0xffff or a car byte offset k*0x41c, built by 0x4091b5) into the 44-byte buffer [0x8914f8] (rep movsw, DF clear), then walks it cyclically from byte offset +0x7d of the car [0x6043f0] (a car record 0..21) and stores the running even counter into byte +0x7d of each listed car (0x66ff6d+word; 0xffff hits 0x66ff6c). +0x7d is the entry offset 2*i (0..42, as list_004083f2), so the walk wraps exactly at the buffer end; an odd or larger offset would read past it and store through garbage offsets.
